domain-information: A seller creates a new item listing in the marketplace catalogue.
A seller uploads photos and writes a short description for the listed item.
A seller sets the price of an item .
A seller confirms the sale once a buyer places an order.
A seller puts the sold item in a package and hands it over to the shipping carrier.
A seller sends a message to a buyer to answer questions.
A buyer browses the online catalogue to find second-hand items of interest.
A buyer sends a message to the seller asking for more details about an item.
A buyer places an order of a certain listing.
A buyer tracks the shipment after the seller confirms dispatch.
A buyer leaves feedback the item is received.
A shipping carrier collects packages from sellers according to scheduled pick-ups.
A shipping carrier updates the takes on the shipment and adjusts its status.
A shipping carrier performs shipment of the package to the buyer’s address.
A marketplace administrator reviews new listings.
A marketplace administrator handles refund requests when a buyer reports an issue with the received item.
A marketplace administrator removes inactive or fraudulent listings from the catalogue.

domain objects.name: Seller
domain objects.description: User who lists and sells second-hand items.

domain objects.name: Item Listing
domain objects.description: Entry in the marketplace showing an item’s details and price.

domain objects.name: Item
domain objects.description: The physical or digital good being sold.

domain objects.name: Price
domain objects.description: The monetary value set for the listed item.

domain objects.name: Buyer
domain objects.description: User who browses listings and purchases items.

domain objects.name: Order
domain objects.description: Purchase request created by a buyer for a specific listing.

domain objects.name: Package
domain objects.description: Container prepared by the seller to ship the sold item.

domain objects.name: Shipping Carrier
domain objects.description: Company responsible for delivering packages from sellers to buyers.

domain objects.name: Marketplace Catalogue
domain objects.description: Collection of all item listings available in the marketplace.

domain objects.name: Shipment
domain objects.description: Delivery process that tracks the package’s status.

domain objects.name: Status
domain objects.description: Current state of the shipment (e.g., pending, in transit, delivered).

domain objects.name: Message
domain objects.description: Communication sent between buyer and seller.

domain objects.name: Dispatch Confirmation
domain objects.description: Notification confirming the item has been shipped.

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Review left by a buyer about the seller or item.

domain objects.name: Marketplace Administrator
domain objects.description: Person who oversees listings and manages marketplace operations.

domain objects.name: Refund Request
domain objects.description: Request submitted by a buyer for reimbursement after an issue.

associations.description: Seller creates and manages Item Listing.
Seller replies to Message from Buyer.
Seller packs sold Item into Package.
Buyer sends Message to Seller with questions.
Buyer places Order for an Item Listing.
Order references the purchased Item Listing.
Buyer browses Marketplace Catalogue to find items.
Seller sends Dispatch Confirmation to Buyer.
Buyer receives Dispatch Confirmation from Seller.
Buyer leaves Feedback after receiving item.
Shipping Carrier collects Package from Seller.
Shipping Carrier manages Shipment and updates Status.
Buyer submits Refund Request after issue.
Marketplace Administrator reviews and moderates Item Listings.
